title: Setting Up Node.js Environment
description: Learn how to install Node.js and set up your development environment to start building Node.js applications.

lessons.title: Downloading Node.js
lessons.content: Visit the official Node.js website (https://nodejs.org) to download the latest LTS version for your operating system (Windows, macOS, Linux).

lessons.title: Installing Node.js
lessons.content: Run the downloaded installer and follow the setup wizard. Verify the installation by running `node -v` and `npm -v` commands in your terminal or command prompt.

lessons.title: Introduction to npm (Node Package Manager)
lessons.content: npm is the default package manager for Node.js. It allows you to install, update, and manage libraries and dependencies for your projects.

lessons.title: Setting Up a Simple Node.js Project
lessons.content: Initialize a new Node.js project by running `npm init` in your project folder. Create a simple 'Hello World' script to test your setup.

lessons.title: Using a Code Editor
lessons.content: Popular code editors like Visual Studio Code provide great support for Node.js development, including syntax highlighting, debugging tools, and integrated terminals.

lessons.title: Running Your First Node.js Script
lessons.content: Write a basic JavaScript file (e.g., `app.js`) and run it using the command `node app.js`. Understand how Node.js executes JavaScript files outside the browser.
